selection_history: Exactly four pre-phase1 scalar candidates were compared on the completed seed20000-20400 H32/H48 cohort. state_effective_rank had the largest absolute overall Spearman (-0.2557) and is the only predictor carried forward. No multivariate model or additional feature search is permitted in this confirmatory test.
predictor: state_effective_rank = exp(entropy(normalized squared singular values of the phase1-pretraining state embedding matrix)), measured after the common uniform A/B base training and before the A-only curriculum
outcome: rank_slope = OLS slope of target25-minus-A_nat 80-20 performance-aligned span versus keep_dim
seed_statistic: Within each seed and hidden width, center predictor and outcome by their five-family means. Pool the 10 centered cells and compute Spearman rho_s between centered state_effective_rank and centered rank_slope.
pooled_statistic: Pool all 50 cells after seed x hidden-width centering and compute Spearman rho_pool.
primary_pass: rho_s < 0 for all 5 fresh seeds; exact one-sided seed sign p=0.03125
all original random-rank rotation audits pass
stopping: Exactly the five listed seeds; no rescue seeds, predictor changes, extra features, nonlinear fits, family exclusions, or threshold changes.
interpretation_if_pass: Evidence that a simple pre-curriculum representation-capacity statistic predicts part of learner-conditioned variation in the shared-coordinate transfer effect in this synthetic GRU setup.
interpretation_if_fail: Stop simple prestate scalar predictor search for this synthetic mechanism sequence. Report that learner-conditioned variability is real but is not captured robustly by the constrained low-dimensional predictors tested here.
